title: SS-6409 — Sabre REST – add /offers/flightShop and /offers/flightShopLite as config-switchable alternatives to /offers/shop
scope: DEV | PUB; S/6NVG | TST101/TST102/TST104 | LHR-JFK 2026-11-20; Y; 1 ADT
summary: Completed user-approved DEV scope: 13 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 WARN. Configured CID routes, empty/unlisted routing, config-only switching, CID overlap priority, endpoint markers, matching top-level option fields and read-only Result retrieval passed. User ended testing at this coverage. No-fallback-on-error was separately user accepted without execution; this adds no executed PASS.
intended: Route listed project/CID entries through their configured Sabre REST endpoint; unlisted traffic uses the default route. All three produce AirAPI output and support revalidation/checkout. User confirmed bargainFinderMax with RestBargainFinderMaxRQ is the intended default route for this test.
limits: 13 executed checks across 7 Search and 4 Result requests, without retries. Configuration discovery is separate evidence in config-discovery.json. Source pairs: runs/2026-10-22/TST101.json, TST102.json, TST104.json and corresponding -result.json files. Same top-level field set does not certify nested field/value parity. Search requests used S/6NVG; returned gds/pcc included E/8C4T for 48/50 TST101 and 183/195 TST104 options; TST102 returned S/6NVG throughout. No assertion of returned GDS/PCC equality was made. Result GET does not establish provider revalidation. Excluded: checkout, booking/ticket writes, revalidation execution, project routing, forced provider errors/no-fallback, SR, and debug=false. SS-6330 research lists mileage/meal/seat/surcharge gaps; no waiver or full nested parity assertion. No operational lessons applied or new reusable operational patterns observed. No ledger update. Empty-list phase evidence: runs/2026-10-22-empty-lists/. Actual list values were null; user explicitly approved this as empty for this test only. Root CSV is for the current CID-overlap phase; original CSV is retained under runs/2026-10-22/. No-fallback-on-error is user accepted but NOT EXECUTED and adds no executed PASS. See acceptance-notes.md. Overlap winner is confirmed as flight_shop; project routing and revalidation/checkout execution remain pending. Overlap evidence: runs/2026-10-22-overlap/; both CID lists contained TST101, both project lists were null. Earlier eight-check and empty-list results retain their original evidence and configuration contexts. User clarified v1/result as the revalidation test operation. TC-13 covers that requested operation for flightShop; TC-06/07/08 previously cover Result for all three routes. No separate provider-internal execution proof or booking checkout is claimed. FINAL HANDOFF: user explicitly ended testing and requested the final report. Project routing, separate booking checkout and full nested field/value parity remain unexecuted. The 13 PASS result certifies only the cases in this table, not every acceptance criterion. Data-gap analysis is in saved-field-gap-analysis.json; no waiver of those differences is inferred. Current rerun CSV requires TST101 in both CID lists. No additional endpoint execution was performed to generate this final report.
